item.title: After tragedy, a planner finds a niche advising women in grief
item.description: Amy Drinkard of Steadmont Advisors advises clients through divorce and deaths, guiding them through some of the hardest parts of their lives — the latest in our Know Your Niche series.

item.title: Schwab to pay $3.8 million over outside advisor's complex recommendations
item.description: Mario Payne — an independent advisor who had used Charles Schwab and TD Ameritrade for custodial services — lands both firms in hot water over his recommendations of risky investment products.

item.title: Referrals still rule as advisors pour time into their brands
item.description: In this month's FACO, we asked how much time advisors spent on their firm's brands, what their marketing objectives were and their main sources of new clients.

item.title: IRS releases proposed regs on Trump accounts
item.description: The pilot program for the new Trump accounts will deposit $1,000 into the accounts of children born between 2025 and 2028.

item.title: A sliver of NYC's wealthy has unusual rallying cry: tax me more
item.description: The members of the "Patriotic Millionaires," who include a Disney heiress, argue that rich residents can afford paying more into city coffers.

item.title: CFP Board launches new 'Dive' ad in $27M awareness campaign
item.description: The spring media buy for the CFP Board's ad push to increase public trust in and visibility of certified financial planners will cost $14.6 million and run to May 17.

item.title: UBS bonus pool rises 10%, Ermotti hovers at $19 Million
item.description: The payouts come as UBS nears completing its integration of Credit Suisse, which it bought in 2023.

item.title: What drives financial advisor well-being? Michael Kitces has answers
item.description: The latest study by The Kitces Report of advisors' well-being found five key drivers of their happiness with work — and many firms are falling short.

item.title: Firms make billions from 'cash sweeps.' Could AI take that away?
item.description: Analysts warn AI agents could automatically move clients' uninvested cash into money markets and other high-yielding investments, depriving brokerages of one of their most lucrative revenue sources.

item.title: Advisor outlook turns negative as Iran war escalates
item.description: After an optimistic start to the year, financial advisors' confidence in the economy and other key indicators fell sharply in March as the United States escalated its bombing campaign in Iran.
